name: gateway_authentication

transport_adapter.rule: Normalize transport credentials into credential_candidates without logging or persisting their values.

invariants: Only an authenticated decision may enter the policy authorization boundary.
Tenant identity comes from verified principal data and cannot be supplied or overridden by the client request.
Authentication proves identity only; model and resource authorization belongs to TASK-M2-003.
Credential values never appear in decisions, public errors, logs, metrics, traces, or persistence.
The online Data Plane authentication path never queries Control Plane PostgreSQL.
Verifier unavailability is indeterminate and never produces an authenticated principal.
